messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The indexer relies on the product catalog for product documents, so if the product catalog is down the indexer is down. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- On 2026-02-10 the Boreal team noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2]
- On 2026-05-27 the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- On 2025-12-18 the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every product catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-18]
- On 2026-02-16 the Dune team noticed that the product catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-16]
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2]
- On 2026-06-04 the Boreal team noticed that the product catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
- Priya Raman holds the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz has the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger service. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- On 2026-06-09 the Dune team observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-06-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-09]
- The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service for per-job kill switches. [valid 2025-02-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-07]
- The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-27; the earlier handover note of 2025-06-11 saying Cinder took ownership was written against the wrong team, and Cinder never owned it. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by Cinder as of 2025-06-11, having moved from the Boreal team. [valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- Dashboards and alerts for the product catalog are being repointed as of the 2025-12-19 handover. [valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- On 2026-03-20 the Boreal team noticed that the product catalog's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2]
- The product catalog can be released on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays; the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC window no longer applies. [constraint; valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03]
    earlier: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to 2025-09-03; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-17]
- The product catalog still relies on the image resizer. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- On 2026-04-01, ownership of the indexer transferred from the Atlas team to the Boreal team. [valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- On 2025-09-23 the Dune team noticed that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23-2]
- On 2025-10-15 the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-15]
